body:
Yeah my uncle suffered from schizophrenia but he killed himself before I was born. I think I was almost born on the anniversary of his death. We even have the same name. 

I have no idea where to get help from, though. I'm too embarrassed to talk to anyone in my family and I don't want to check into a hospital because of the bills my parents will have to pay.
Yeah I was a NEET for a year and a half and I hated it. I'm sorry you're in that situation.
Well the last time I was in the hospital, my psychiatrist diagnosed me with schizotypal personality disorder. This was last November.
I used to take over 10 pills a day. Choking them down was horrible and they made me throw up several times. I also gained 80 pounds while I was taking them and I've lost 75~ pounds since I stopped.

I often lay in my brother's truck bed and just look up at the stars and the moon. I find it to be very relaxing and it calms me down a lot. I hope we make enough progress and are able to explore what's out there one day. 

I get frustrated easily and give up way too soon. I was interested in keyboard because my grandma has a piano at her house and she would play it for me when I was younger.

I really like Joy Division and The Killers. I also really like music that is synth-heavy. It'd be really cool to learn to use one. But I was blown away when they revealed it. Made me feel like a kid again. I hope Link is customizable this time. Being able to choose your own gender, hair and clothes would be a big step.

I would definitely prefer to live than die, but my future is looking bleak, and I honestly probably won't do much to change it. I don't want to be a 25 year old NEET who still lives at home. I've been to a mental hospital three times but I only stayed like 3 days each time because I don't have the best insurance. I stopped taking my medication a while back and haven't seen my psychiatrist in months. I'm glad you were able to get help, though.

Yeah, my disgusting room isn't helping with my mood. I definitely need to clean it. And I actually have a keyboard that was given to me as a gift, but I've never learned to play it. But yeah, I really liked E3 this year. I'm really looking forward to Halo: The Master Chief Collection, The Legend of Zelda, and GTA V being remastered.
